body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Simone de Beauvoir
paras: Simone de Beauvoir was born in Paris in 1908 and **studied** philosophy at the Sorbonne, **where** she met Jean-Paul Sartre. Her **lifelong** partnership with him **became** one of the most discussed intellectual relationships of the twentieth century.

In *The Ethics of Ambiguity* (1947), Beauvoir **tried to reconcile** individual freedom with **responsibility toward others**: a person is free, **yet** her freedom **is only real** when she **wills** the freedom of others. Two years later, *The Second Sex* (1949) **examined** how **women are made, not born**, and **became a landmark** of feminist thought.
She also **wrote novels**; *The Mandarins* **won** the Prix Goncourt in 1954. Beauvoir **died** in Paris in 1986, **leaving** a body of work that **continues to be debated**.
facts: The Ethics of Ambiguity; The Second Sex; The Mandarins

blocks.body: **Reconcile A with B** = tornar compatíveis duas coisas em tensão (ou **be reconciled to** = aceitar). **Yet** e **and yet** marcam a tensão entre ideias.
*Reconcile with* (A com B) × *be reconciled with someone* (fazer as pazes com alguém).

items.s: Beauvoir tried to ___ freedom with responsibility. (reconcile)
A person is free, ___ her freedom is real only when she wills others’ freedom. (yet)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: What did Beauvoir try to reconcile

body: **Reconcile with** — conciliar com
**Come to terms with** — aceitar
**Strike a balance** — encontrar equilíbrio
**Torn between** — dividido entre
**Have it both ways** — querer os dois lados
**Bridge the gap** — preencher a lacuna
**Break new ground** — abrir novos caminhos
**Stand the test of time** — resistir ao tempo
**Make a landmark contribution** — dar contribuição marcante
**Leave a lasting mark** — deixar marca duradoura
**What did Beauvoir try to reconcile?** — O que Beauvoir tentou conciliar?
**Individual freedom with responsibility toward others.** — A liberdade individual com a responsabilidade para com os outros.
**And The Second Sex?** — E O Segundo Sexo?

forms: She tried to reconcile duty with desire.
Ela tentou conciliar dever e desejo.

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.q: Summarize a life in two sentences.
prompts.model: Beauvoir was born in Paris in 1908. She died there in 1986.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence mini-biography of a thinker, using reconcile, yet and a past-simple narrative.
blocks.model: Immanuel Kant was born in Königsberg in 1724. He tried to reconcile reason with experience. His books are demanding, yet they changed philosophy. He taught for decades and rarely left his city. He died in 1804. His ideas continue to be debated.

items.why: **lifelong partnership** = parceria de toda a vida.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
